root_decision: Accept this small local-only scheduling/grouping configuration with complete affected RD-native checks and operational build regression. The measured first uncached compilation benefit needs no additional CPU allocation or scientific-code changes. Further costly samples are not justified for this bounded change.
limits: One sequential paired observation, not a statistically established or universal speedup; resource snapshots and unfavorable timing/RSS observations remain.
Only RD native was rebuilt; five identified companion natives were reused. Actual source-mode native origins,17tests/core smoke each are not installed-wheel or six-fresh-native evidence.
Full pip installation was not remeasured. The13.567% benefit applies to the RD-native compile/link closure, not overall installation.
Per-child rusage RSS maxima do not measure simultaneous aggregate process-tree peak memory.
No new strict probe/release/SDK/other-ABI qualification; those effective build configurations remain original. Scientific population/performance parity is not claimed.
Persistent incremental/compiled-cache work remains separate P20-D042; no extraction/network/pip-isolation shortcut is introduced.
